response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with other or missing types are excluded from both averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Other or missing types are excluded only from the signed amount average; their balances still count when the amount is at least 2400.
